Court upholds ban on PepsiCo's Sting energy drink production

PepsiCo has warned of a nationwide stockout of its Sting energy drink after the Delhi High Court denied the company urgent relief to resume new production. The court maintained its ban on the use of the term 'energy drink' for Sting's labeling and marketing. PepsiCo had sought an interim order to lift the ban, but the court stated it would hear the matter further. The company's plea was dismissed, with the court indicating it would review the case in detail.
